image.alt: Teacher sharing a picture book with a group of children

body_text: A language-rich environment helps children fall in love with words, stories and self-expression. We use the Letterland phonics programme alongside stories, conversations, rhymes, books and play.
title: Four Essential Skills
subtitle: Listening · Speaking · Reading · Writing
list_items: Listening: listening, understanding, responding and enjoying stories
Speaking: finding their voice, building vocabulary and expressing ideas
Reading: discovering sounds, letters, words and the joy of books
Writing: from marks and drawings to letters, words and sentences

image_2.alt: Boy experimenting with water and sorting colourful blocks

body_text_2: Children see mathematics in blocks, patterns, water play, shapes and everyday problem-solving. Inspired by Singapore Math, they move from real objects to pictures, and then to numbers and symbols (Concrete–Pictorial–Abstract), building deep understanding instead of rote memorisation.
list_items_2: Number sense: counting, quantity and number relationships
Measurement: length, weight, capacity and time
Problem solving, reasoning and explaining ideas
Data: sorting, classifying and representing information

image_3.alt: Girl observing a plant closely through a magnifying glass

body_text_3: Children learn by experiencing the world directly: wondering about people, noticing changes in nature and asking how things work. Thematic learning brings real life into the classroom through stories, nature walks, research and simple experiments.
list_items_3: Nature & science: plants, animals, seasons and weather
People & our world: families, communities and cultures
Asking questions, predicting, trying things out
Caring for our world and using resources thoughtfully
Everyday life: how things work and why events happen
